known_caveats: The 400-row full pool is not formal accuracy because it is not fully human-reviewed.
DeepSeek Prediction Statistics are model-output dashboard statistics, not formal accuracy.
I-4E.4 product_category normalization is a secondary interpretation layer and does not replace the I-4E.2 formal result.
product_category taxonomy alignment remains a known follow-up issue.
The dataset is synthetic and should be described as dissertation/system evaluation data, not an industrial benchmark.
recommended_next_steps: Finalize dissertation chapters using the I-6AB material package.
Capture or organize UI screenshots for the system implementation and defense presentation.
Optionally implement a product_category normalization module as a separate future optimization.
Optionally add a FastAPI service layer for deployment-oriented demonstration.
Prepare defense slides using formal evaluation and dashboard evidence.
